PERSPECTIVE / INSTITUTIONAL CAPABILITY

Better records are a means. Better decisions are the goal.

A digital system earns its place when its information supports a real decision.

BELDIUM PERSPECTIVES · OCTOBER 2026 · ADVISORY COMMENTARY

Define the decision before the database

Start with who must act, the authority under which they act and the information needed. This helps distinguish useful records from administrative burden.

Treat verification as a design question

A record is not the same as verified evidence. Data sources, update rules, access permissions and the handling of discrepancies need to be specified. Traceability depends on the integrity of the events recorded.

Build for use and ownership

Workflow design, staff capability and institutional responsibilities matter as much as software. A pilot should evaluate whether the system improves the intended decision, rather than measuring only how many records it captures.

This perspective presents an analytical approach. It is not a report of a completed assignment or a country-specific assessment.
